gaps: Rank 1 user criterion (lead weekly operational performance reviews) is marked missing in the tailoringPlan, but entry:ev-head:row:1 states the candidate runs a weekly performance review against published measures; the bullet rests on that row and should be checked by the reviewer.

r6 supplier negotiation: no explicit negotiation evidence in the library. The supplier scorecard and quarterly service-level reviews (entry:ev-head:row:4) show supplier performance management, not negotiation; the tailoringPlan cites row 0, which does not mention suppliers.

r7 is a customised label (lead multi-site service delivery) whose retained quote concerns the degree requirement; multi-site delivery is supported by entry:ev-head:row:0 and the degree by the Education entry, but the reviewer should confirm which meaning is intended.
Advert describes a portfolio of twelve sites; confirmed evidence is eleven community clinics as Head of Operations and four clinics as Operations Manager. No claim of twelve sites has been made.

r4 five years in a regulated environment: tenure at Northwind Health runs Jan 2018 to present and the stored industry description includes Regulated services; no separate statement of the regulatory regime exists in the library.

Skills section now cites entry:ev-skills:skill:0 for the SQL label, correcting the earlier citation of the prose row; Power BI, NetSuite, Process mapping and Vendor management were not listed as relevant skill items and are omitted.
Layout refit: Head of Operations consolidated from five to four bullets and the summary shortened to fit the two-page limit; all experience, education and qualification entries retained.
